method.comparison_curve: value at each round EXCLUDING keepers, so a keeper is judged against what the round would have returned had they been let go
method.pool: each season's own resolved draftees; absent players stay in the pool at zero
method.prior_value: the same players' PREVIOUS season, valued identically — a decision-time baseline, NOT the app's projection board, which did not exist before 2026
method.realized_value: season actuals through compute_*_sgp, playing-time discount off, streaming bonus 0
